description: The producer→consumer round trip: verified marks go out as entries, and a separate project reads them back through the resolver chain. The producer strips comments, so the manifest is the only carrier left. `async` is asserted on the entry rather than through the consumer on purpose — emit writes only non-throwing entries, and a non-throwing promise needs no bridge, so what makes the flag load-bearing is a throwing entry, which is `manifest-async-flag-absent-fails`'s counterfactual and not a shape emit can produce.
